sections.text:
Repeat steps of annual inspection, MPIS Document no.
 CB-020-r0

Check internal tightness of hydraulic components and
 take care during tightness without pressure.

Check there is no condensation in the cabinets
 operation of the heaters.
Check the condition of the electrical connections.

Check leakage of gas from threshold of SF6 pressure
 regulators using gas detector.

Measure Operating time of the CB 70 ms close, 40 ms trip,
 120 ms close trip.

Externally clean the control cabinet and breaker using
 a blower.

Clean the inside of the control cabinet and inspect
 equipment mounting heater operation, door gasket condition.

Generally inspect the breaker for any defects including
 grounding electrical, conditions, deteriorating of hoses and electrical
 cables.

text:
Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks
 I2,
 which must be performed every three years as indicated by
 Y3
 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
CB must be isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB area is
 required.
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage).
Tools and Equipment
Hydraulic Test
 gauge, SF6 test gauge, blower, dew-point equipment, acidity equipment air
 contoiut equipment, timing equipment.and contact resistance equipment.
Work to be Carried Out
Repeat steps of annual inspection, MPIS Document no.
 CB-020-r0
Check internal tightness of hydraulic components and
 take care during tightness without pressure.
Check there is no condensation in the cabinets
 operation of the heaters.
Check the condition of the electrical connections.
Check leakage of gas from threshold of SF6 pressure
 regulators using gas detector.
Measure Operating time of the CB 70 ms close, 40 ms trip,
 120 ms close trip.
Externally clean the control cabinet and breaker using
 a blower.
Clean the inside of the control cabinet and inspect
 equipment mounting heater operation, door gasket condition.
Generally inspect the breaker for any defects including
 grounding electrical, conditions, deteriorating of hoses and electrical
 cables.
